hero.title: Taste India's Vibrant Street Food Culture at Street Foods by Punjab Grill
hero.subtitle: Indulge in an authentic explosion of flavors, crafted with the renowned culinary expertise of Punjab Grill.

about.title: Experience Authentic Indian Street Flavors
about.paragraph1: Street Foods by Punjab Grill Mantri Square Mall invites you on a delectable journey through India's most iconic street food traditions. We've meticulously recreated the bustling, vibrant street scene, offering everything from tangy chaats and crispy pakoras to succulent tandoori skewers, all infused with the signature quality of Punjab Grill.
about.paragraph2: Our commitment is to authenticity, hygiene, and an unforgettable culinary experience. Each dish is prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients, ensuring a burst of genuine flavor in every bite. Whether you're craving a quick, spicy snack or a fulfilling meal, find your perfect street food adventure conveniently located within Mantri Square Mall.
